micah.7.p1.b1.text: Woe is me! For I am like one gathering summer fruit at the gleaning of the vineyard; there is no cluster to eat, no early fig that I crave.

micah.7.p1.b2.text: The godly man has perished from the earth; there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; they hunt one another with a net.

micah.7.p1.b3.text: Both hands are skilled at evil; the prince and the judge demand a bribe. When the powerful utters his evil desire, they all conspire together.

micah.7.p1.b4.text: For a son dishonors his father, a daughter rises against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law. A man’s enemies are the members of his own household.

micah.7.p1.b5.text: But as for me, I will look to the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.

micah.7.p1.b6.text: Do not gloat over me, my enemy! Though I have fallen, I will arise; though I sit in darkness, the LORD will be my light.

micah.7.p1.b7.text: Then my enemy will see and will be covered with shame— she who said to me, “Where is the LORD your God?”

micah.7.p2.b1.text: The day for rebuilding your walls will come— the day for extending your boundary.

micah.7.p2.b2.text: On that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, even from Egypt to the Euphrates, from sea to sea and mountain to mountain.

micah.7.p2.b3.text: Shepherd with Your staff Your people, the flock of Your inheritance. They live alone in a woodland, surrounded by pastures.

micah.7.p2.b4.text: Nations will see and be ashamed, deprived of all their might. They will put their hands over their mouths, and their ears will become deaf.

micah.7.p2.b5.text: Who is a God like You, who pardons iniquity and passes over the transgression of the remnant of His inheritance— who does not retain His anger forever, because He delights in loving devotion?

micah.7.p2.b6.text: He will again have compassion on us … You will cast out all our sins into the depths of the sea.

micah.7.p2.b7.text: You will show faithfulness to Jacob and loving devotion to Abraham, as You swore to our fathers from the days of old.
